work.text: Speaker catalog: SVP of Engineering, Jellyfish.

Adam is SVP of Engineering at Jellyfish, where he leads the technology strategy that helps engineering organizations measure and maximize the impact of AI-powered development tools, including GitHub Copilot.

With more than two decades of experience scaling world-class engineering teams (including as CTO of Endeca through its $1 billion acquisition by Oracle, and at Salsify, where he helped grow the business to over $150 million in ARR), Adam brings a rare combination of deep technical craft and executive leadership.
